~Tsunami Cake~ Making use of my blue pea powder to create this tsunami cake. The method is similar to my Hurricane cake roll.  A Bain Marie (water bath) gives a soft and moist cake. I just can’t stop jiggling my cake  (toink toink)😄😜 Yolk batter 6 yolks 100g milk 50g oil 100g low protein flour (cake flour) Vanilla essense (optional)  4g blue pea powder Meringue 6 whites 90g sugar 6g lemon juice ➡️ Mix oil and milk until no strip of oil seen ➡️ add the sieved cake flour and mix well ➡️ add egg yolks and mix well ➡️ split yolk batter into 70% and 30% ➡️ add blue pea powder to the 30% batter ➡️ beat egg whites with lemon juice with high speed, add 1/3 sugar when big bubbles seen ➡️ continue beating and add 1/3 sugar when meringue form finer bubbles ➡️ add last 1/3 sugar when meringue shows some line while beating  ➡️ beat meringue to firm/medium peak ➡️ split meringue into 70% and 30% ➡️ fold the meringue to the yolk batter accordingly ➡️ pour 120g plain batter into piping bag  ➡️ pour the balance plain batter into 18x18cm square pan (line bottom and lightly grease the side)  ➡️ pour or pipe the blue pea batter on top ➡️ Use the back of spoon to draw lines. Spoon shall touch the bottom of pan all the times without breaking.  ➡️ Once done drawing one direction, turn the pan around 90 degree and repeat the same   ➡️ pipe the 120g plain batter on top ➡️ bake at 150C for 1hr 15-30mins with water bath (bain-marie) method  ➡️ remove cake from oven and demould right away  #tsunamicake #ogura #oguracake #softcake #cake #fluffycake #相思蛋糕 #spongecake #chiffoncake #waterbath #bainmarie #steambake #bluepea #bluepeacake

🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or anyone who loves desserts that are out of this world! 🌠 #GalaxyCake #MirrorGlaze #ChocolateDessert #CosmicBaking #ShowstopperCake

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! I find it’s easier to ice the sponges when they are frozen/cold. Enjoy! :) #chocolate #cake #brownie #baking #recipes

VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Torta od borovnice i vanilije 🫐 Nježna, kremasta i bogata ukusom. Slojevi aromatične kreme od vanilije i sočnih borovnica, spojeni sa hrskavim beze korama. Volim ovakve kombinacije — kada se nježna krema od vanilije, svježina borovnica i hrskave beze kore spoje u jedan zalogaj. 🤍 Za dvije beze kore Za jednu koru: * 6 bjelanaca * 240 g šećera * 2 kašike limunovog soka Bjelanca umutiti pjenasto, pa postepeno dodavati šećer. Mutiti dok se šećer potpuno ne otopi, zatim dodati limunov sok i mutiti još kratko. Pleh prečnika 30 cm obložiti papirom za pečenje, rasporediti smjesu i sušiti koru 90 minuta na 120 °C. Na isti način napraviti i drugu koru. Krema od vanilije: * 12 žumanaca * 200 g šećera * zrnca vanilije * 200 g umućenog putera * 200 g mascarponea Žumanca umutiti sa šećerom dok ne postanu svijetla i pjenasta. Dodati zrnca vanilije, pa kuhati na pari uz stalno miješanje oko 30 minuta. Kada se krema potpuno ohladi, dodati umućeni puter i dobro sjediniti. Zatim dodati mascarpone i ponovo sve sjediniti. Sos od borovnica: * 300 g borovnica * 50 g putera * 40 g šećera Dobro zagrijati tiganj, dodati puter, a zatim odmah borovnice i šećer. Borovnice samo blago promiješati, otprilike 1 minut, tek toliko da se sve sjedini, a da ostanu cijele. Slaganje: Beze kora → borovnice → krema od vanilije → druga beze kora → borovnice → krema od vanilije. Tortu premazati šlagom i dekorisati po želji. 🫐🤍 #tortaodborovnice #tortaodvanilije #domacetorte #receptzatortu #kolaci

The epitome of chocolate heaven🍫🤩🍰 if you love chocolate, you need this crockpot chocolate lava cake in your life!🙌 Crockpot Chocolate Lava Cake Recipe: Ingredients:  Cake Batter: 1 cup all-purpose flour ¾ cup granulated sugar 3 tbsps cocoa powder 2 tsps baking powder  ¼ tsp salt ½ cup milk ⅓ cup butter ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 tsps vanilla bean paste Cake Topping: ¾ cup granulated sugar ¾ cup light brown sugar ⅓ cup cocoa powder ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 ¼ cup hot water Instructions: 1. Mix cake batter dry ingredients: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, granulated sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.  2. Mix cake batter wet ingredients: In a separate bowl, microwave your butter and dark chocolate chips in 30 second increments until fully melted.  3. Combine your wet & dry ingredients, & spread it on the bottom of your crockpot. 4. Cake Topping: Mix your granulated sugar, brown sugar, & cocoa powder together. Sprinkle this on top of your cake batter along with the chocolate chips. Pour your hot water overtop of everything, & don’t stir it in. 5. Cover, & cook on high for 2-2.5 hours. 🍫 GÂTEAU VOLCAN  Dimensions du moule ➡️Env. 22 × 18 cm  Ingrédients ➤ Gâteau 	•	3 œufs 	•	170 g d’huile neutre 	•	100g de sucre 	•	75 g de cacao non sucré 	•	240 g d’eau chaude 	•	180 g de farine 	•	15 g de levure chimique 	•	1 c. café rase de bicarbonate ➤ Sirop chocolat 	•	480 g de lait 	•	120 g de cacao 	•	30 g de beurre ➤ Ganache 	•	200 g de chocolat (noir, lait ou mix) 	•	200 g de crème liquide Étapes : Préchauffe ton four à 180°C chaleur tournante. Dans un grand bol, fouette ensemble les œufs, le sucre, l’huile, le cacao et l’eau chaude jusqu’à obtenir une pâte lisse. Ajoute la farine, la levure et le bicarbonate et mélange juste assez pour que la pâte soit homogène. Verse dans un moule beurré ou huilé d’environ 22 × 18 cm et enfourne 25 minutes, en surveillant dès 20 minutes : le centre doit rester tremblotant. Pendant la cuisson, prépare le sirop chocolat en chauffant le lait, le sucre, le cacao et le beurre jusqu’aux premiers frémissements puis coupe le feu. Dès que le gâteau sort du four, verse tout le sirop dessus et laisse absorber 10 à 15 minutes. Fais chauffer la crème, verse-la sur le chocolat, laisse fondre puis mélange et nappe le dessus. Sers tiède, à la cuillère, texture volcan garantie 😍🍫

These were out of this world 🤤 Soulistic Lava Cakes Ingredients 	•	60g unsalted butter 	•	85g dark chocolate 	•	55g coconut sugar 	•	1 large egg 	•	1 large egg yolk (room temperature) 	•	1 tsp vanilla extract 	•	1 tbsp Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao 	•	2 tsp plain flour 	•	Pinch sea salt To serve (optional): 	•	Dusting of Soulistic  Method 1. Preheat your oven to 220°C (200°C fan-forced). Generously grease and lightly dust two 180ml ramekins (or three 120ml ramekins) with Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao 	 2. Melt the butter and chocolate together over low heat on stove consistently stirring between, until smooth. 3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the coconut sugar, egg, egg yolk and vanilla until slightly fluffy (an electric hand mixer works best). 4. Pour the melted chocolate mixture into the egg mixture and stir until combined. 5. Gently fold through the Soulistic Bone Broth Cacao, flour and salt until just combined. 6. Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. 7. Bake for 10–11 minutes (for 180ml ramekins) or 7–8 minutes (for 120ml ramekins). The edges should be set while the centre remains slightly wobbly. 8. Let the cakes rest for 2–3 minutes, then carefully invert onto serving plates. 9. Serve immediately with a dusting of Soulistic and enjoy!
